title: The Case of the Missing Lunch
mainIdea: Working together and asking for help can solve problems more easily.

pages.text: Timmy was upset because his favorite lunchbox was missing.
Timmy searched the classroom but could not find his lunchbox.
His friends noticed he was upset and decided to help him search.
The friends remembered that Timmy had his lunchbox during recess and searched the playground.

question.text: What did Timmy and his friends do?
options: They searched for clues and looked outside
They asked the teacher for a new lunchbox

pages.text: Near the swings, they found the lunchbox. Timmy was happy and thanked his friends.

options: The lunchbox stayed missing until the end of the week
Timmy found his lunchbox with his friends' help
Timmy bought a brand new lunchbox at the school store

distractors: To share lunch with a friend

elements.correct: He could not find it by himself
distractors: He was late for the lunch bell
He had no money to buy lunch
His friends stopped looking for it
His teacher gave him a new lunchbox

elements.correct: They found the lunchbox near the swings
distractors: They found the lunchbox in the lost bin
They gave up and went back to class
